The '''1958–59 [[Eliteserien|Hovedserien]]''' was the 15th completed season of top division [[association football|football]] in [[Norway]].

==Overview==
It was contested by 16 teams, and [[Lillestrøm SK|Lillestrøm]] won the championship, their first league title.
